meta.title: Improve TPCH query compilation
meta.body_summary: Improve TPC-H query compilation by adding a hash combine runtime helper, tracking element types in query compilation, and generating struct keys for grouped queries.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added struct key hashing and element type tracking in the C++ compiler; merged by same maintainer with only a single commit and no review discussion.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 492 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume. As a compiler optimization PR, it fits a typical incremental improvement and was merged quickly by the maintainer without review.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review or comments were provided; the PR was self-merged by the author with a single commit.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve TPC-H query compilation correctness and performance by adding hash combine helper and generating struct keys.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Compiler-level optimization with runtime helper addition and type tracking is within agent capability for this repo; merge required no human engagement.

core_change_summary.description: In the C++ compiler, added a _hash_combine runtime helper for hashing struct keys, tracked element types in query compilation, and generated struct keys for grouped queries when the key is a map literal. Also added a TPC-H golden test and test output files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test and output files were added for TPC-H Q2 validation; TASKS.md updated with task tracking.
